description: "Aesthetical Essays of Friedrich Schiller" by Friedrich Schiller is a philosophical work written during the late 18th century. This collection encompasses a range of essays and letters that explore the nature of aesthetics, the role of beauty and art in human experience, and the moral implications of artistic expression.
